Title: Passkey — store that requires MFA lets a passkey sign-in through without a code
Preconditions:
Build under test: platform 3.1091.0-pr-3144, storefront theme 2.61.0-pr-2601, Passkeys module 3.1000.0-pr-1, Customer module with customer#324 - all open PRs on 2026-10-28. On a stand without them the case is BLOCKED for the build, never FAIL, and is never re-based to the older behaviour.
CEREMONY: Chromium lanes only (playwright-chrome or playwright-edge, never firefox). Before the first step a WebAuthn virtual authenticator is set up through the Chrome DevTools Protocol: WebAuthn.enable, then WebAuthn.addVirtualAuthenticator {protocol: ctap2, transport: internal, hasResidentKey: true, hasUserVerification: true, isUserVerified: true, automaticPresenceSimulation: true}; capture authenticatorId; it is removed in Cleanup. On the Edge lane the window needs focus (select the tab) before every create or get, or the ceremony silently does nothing.
Persona @td(PK_BUYER.email) (B2B buyer of {{STORE_ID}}, one organization) is seeded by scripts/seed-data/auth/seed-passkey.mjs; re-arm it before the run with npm run seed:passkey:verify (unlock, failed-attempt count 0, leftover passkeys removed). The case registers its own passkeys in the virtual authenticator and deletes every passkey it created in Cleanup.
REQUIRES the MFA module (VirtoCommerce.MFA, 3.1000.1 on the stand that carries this change). On a stand without the module the case is BLOCKED for the build, never FAIL.
OPERATOR WINDOW W2 (store): {{STORE_ID}} MultiFactorAuthentication.StoreMode = Enabled, set by the operator in Admin (Stores > {{STORE_ID}} > Settings > Security) before the run and restored by the operator after it; the case only READS the store to assert the window state and is BLOCKED (needs operator window W2) otherwise. While it is open EVERY password sign-in on {{STORE_ID}} is challenged: this suite holds the exclusiveGroup platform-setting:MultiFactorAuthentication, which separates it from the MFA suites 110 and 111 only - run it alone, never beside any other sign-in suite on the store.
Open author question Q4: what "a passkey counts as MFA" means (user verification only, or an amr claim). This case asserts only what is not in question: no emailed code is asked after a passkey, and the sign-in succeeds.
Steps:
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username={{ADMIN_EMAIL}}, password={{ADMIN_PASSWORD}}) to obtain an admin Bearer token
[SETUP] READ ONLY: GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} with the admin Bearer; read settings[] MultiFactorAuthentication.StoreMode and require Enabled; otherwise BLOCKED (needs operator window W2)
[SETUP] set up the virtual authenticator over CDP (Preconditions CEREMONY)
--- LAYER: Register the key (the password sign-in is challenged, so the key is added through the xAPI of the buyer) ---
[AUTH] POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=password, username=@td(PK_BUYER.email), password={{DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD}}, storeId={{STORE_ID}}); capture the two_factor_required answer
[HTTP] read the code from the notification journal (MfaSignInEmailNotification for the buyer, readLatestMfaCode) and exchange it at POST {{BACK_URL}}/connect/token (grant_type=mfa) to obtain the buyer Bearer token
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/ (a page of the storefront host: the relying-party id of the ceremony is this host)
[HTTP] POST {{FRONT_URL}}/graphql with the buyer Bearer and {passkeyCreationOptions}; capture creationOptions
[ACT] In the page run navigator.credentials.create with creationOptions parsed as publicKey
[CAPTURE] credCreate = the result serialised with toJSON()
[HTTP] POST {{FRONT_URL}}/graphql with the buyer Bearer and mutation createPasskey(command:{credential: credCreate}){succeeded errors{code description}}; require succeeded=true
--- SCREEN: Passkey sign-in on the MFA store ---
[PRE:CLEAR_SESSION]
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/sign-in
[CAPTURE] T0 = current UTC time
[ACT] Click 'Sign in with Passkey'
[WAIT] the page leaves /sign-in or a code step appears (up to 15s)
[ASSERT] Read whether the heading "Enter the sign-in code" is shown and the account button
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/notifications/journal with the admin Bearer and {"notificationType":"MfaSignInEmailNotification","keyword":"@td(PK_BUYER.email)","take":5,"sort":"createdDate:desc"}; capture rowsAfter
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/sign-in-log/search with the admin Bearer and JSON body {"userName":"@td(PK_BUYER.email)","startDate":T0,"take":20,"sort":"createdDate:desc"}
[CAPTURE] logRows = the rows of that search with createdDate after T0 (poll up to 90s for the Passkey row; the writer is buffered)
Assertions:
[STATE] The passkey sign-in completes with no code step: the heading "Enter the sign-in code" is never shown and the account button names the buyer {SPEC} (VCST-6121: a passkey satisfies MFA, no extra one-time code) {OBSERVED} (111 MFASF-001: the heading text of the code step)
[COUNT] rowsAfter holds no MfaSignInEmailNotification created after T0 for the buyer: no code email was sent for the passkey sign-in {SPEC} (VCST-6121)
[COUNT] logRows holds at least one Passkey row with succeeded=true and holds no row with signInType MFA after T0 {OBSERVED} (110 MFA-019: an MFA step writes its own MFA row; a passkey writes none)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[API] POST /connect/token grant_type=passkey answers 200 with an access_token and no two_factor_required
[CONSOLE] no TypeError
[NETWORK] no 5xx on /connect/token
[ERRORS] errors[] of every GraphQL answer in this case is empty, except where an assertion above expects the refusal
Failure_Signals: The passkey sign-in still asks for an emailed code; a code email is sent anyway; the log shows an MFA row for the passkey sign-in; the store window is not restored
